notes: Studio condenser microphone (multi-pattern, switchable via 5 polar patterns), phantom-powered — there is no separate DC/power port; 48V P48 phantom power is delivered over the same 3-pin XLR audio output. Verified against manufacturer's official spec page (neumann.com). Weight 400g, diameter 46mm, length 185mm — desktop/handheld studio mic, not rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted. No grade applies since XLR3 (balanced analog audio) is not one of the bandwidth-graded connector types.

ports.name: Audio Output
ports.note: 3-pin male XLR balanced audio output; powered via 48V ± 4V phantom power (P48, IEC 61938) supplied over the same XLR line — no separate power connector
